levels.surface: علي بن أحمد بن محمد بن عمران الدقاق
محمد ابن أبي عبد الله الكوفي

notes: «رحمه الله» is a formula: left out

the chain ends at «أبي عبد الله» (narrator, Imam written after «عن»); inside the scene «أمير المؤمنين» speaks and acts (the answer, the fainting of Dhi'lib): a narrated encounter with the Imam speaking and acting, so per rule 11 he is not added as a link and the ruling is open
the matn's «قال مصنف هذا الكتاب» is the compiler's own comment: left out
